# Exhibition catalogue {#sec-exhibition-catalogue} This part of the book presents the exhibition itself: where and when it was shown, the artist, the catalogue that accompanied it, and the works, with a mark for each work that was on view. ## Exhibition ::: {#exhibition-info .cell execution_count=2} *BALDESSARI : While something is happening here, something else is happening there : Works 1988–1999*
Venue Dates Works on view Wikidata

Follow the link to see its open, reusable record: - [Sprengel Museum Hannover](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141747732) ::: ::: ## Artist ::: {#artist-info .cell execution_count=3} **John Baldessari** ([Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q683378)) - **Born:** 17 June 1931, National City - **Died:** 2 January 2020, Venice - **Nationality:** United States - **Works as:** architect, conceptual artist, draftsperson, illustrator, installation artist, painter, photographer, printmaker, sculptor, video artist - **Studied at:** San Diego State University; University of California, Berkeley - **Awards:** Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences; Goslarer Kaiserring; Guggenheim Fellowship; Spectrum – Internationaler Preis für Fotografie ::: ## Catalogue ::: {#catalogue-info .cell execution_count=4} - **Title:** BALDESSARI : While something is happening here, something else is happening there : Works 1988–1999 - **Authors:** Thomas Weski; Diedrich Diederichsen; Meg Cranston - **Publisher:** König - **Year:** 1999 - **ISBN:** 978-3-88375-396-6 ::: ## Artworks ::: {#artwork-list .cell execution_count=5} The catalogue documents **73 works**. **35** of them were on view in the exhibition (marked ✓); the other 38 are reproduced in the catalogue only.
